request_text_excerpt: Subject: CPRA 25-1883 — Request to Identify Prior Productions and Withheld Records; Objection to Closure To the City of Berkeley: On August 21, 2025, Deputy City Attorney Sam Harvey stated that the City had identified records responsive to request 25-1883, that one record was provided under 25-1882, that additional records had been provided under unspecified prior requests, and that all remaining responsive records were withheld under attorney-client and attorney work product privileges.
